mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number) VALUES (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber})
mapper.update:
update orders
status = #{status},
pay_status = #{payStatus},
pay_method = #{payMethod},
cancel_reason = #{cancelReason},
rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason},
cancel_time = #{cancelTime},
checkout_time = #{checkoutTime},
delivery_time = #{deliveryTime},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select Date(order_time) as date,coalesce(sum(amount),0) as turnover from orders where order_time between #{begin} and #{end} and status = 5 group by Date(order_time);

select od.name as dishName,sum(od.number) as dishCount from order_detail as od ,orders as o where o.id = od.order_id and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end} and o.status = 5 group by od.name order by dishCount desc ;
select Date(order_time) as date,count(id) as OrderCount from orders where order_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime} group by Date(order_time);
select Date(order_time) as date,count(id) as EffectiveCount from orders where order_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime} and status = 5 group by Date(order_time);
